DLG-SC-LOC-SAG-URESHINO-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SAG-URESHINO-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 口座の申込みですね。お使いになる目的と、現在のお住まいを確認させてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SAG-URESHINO-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: An account application, then. Please let us check its purpose and your current residence.

DLG-SC-LOC-SAG-URESHINO-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SAG-URESHINO-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 旅館の仕事の給与を受け取るためです。先週、嬉野市の社員寮へ引っ越しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-SAG-URESHINO-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 旅館の給与受取りが目的で、先週嬉野市の社員寮に転居したと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SAG-URESHINO-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: To receive my inn-job wages. Last week I moved to a company dormitory in Ureshino City.
DLG-SC-LOC-SAG-URESHINO-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain receiving inn wages and moving to an Ureshino company dormitory last week. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SAG-URESHINO-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SAG-URESHINO-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの在留カードには前の住所が載っていますね。転居後の住所変更は、もうお済みですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SAG-URESHINO-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: This residence card shows your old address. Have you completed the address change since moving?

DLG-SC-LOC-SAG-URESHINO-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SAG-URESHINO-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだです。寮の住所が書かれた会社の書類なら持っていますが、これで今日申し込めますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SAG-URESHINO-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 在留カードの住所変更は未了だが、寮の住所がある会社書類を持っていると伝え、本日申込み可能か尋ねる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SAG-URESHINO-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. I have company papers showing the dormitory address; can I apply today with them?
DLG-SC-LOC-SAG-URESHINO-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the card address is not updated but company dormitory-address papers are available and ask about applying today. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SAG-URESHINO-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SAG-URESHINO-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この書類は勤務先の確認には使えますが、当行では現住所が確認できる本人確認書類も必要です。住所変更を済ませた在留カードを、次回お持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SAG-URESHINO-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: These papers can confirm employment, but our bank also needs identification confirming your current address. Bring an updated residence card next time.

DLG-SC-LOC-SAG-URESHINO-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SAG-URESHINO-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 住所を変更してから来ます。そのときに持ってくる物を忘れないよう、この会社の書類も必要か教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SAG-URESHINO-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 住所変更後に来店すると伝え、次回も会社書類を持参する必要があるか確認する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SAG-URESHINO-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll come after changing the address. So I don't forget what to bring, please tell me whether these company papers are needed too.
DLG-SC-LOC-SAG-URESHINO-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Return after address updating and check whether company papers are needed next time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SAG-URESHINO-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SAG-URESHINO-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、在留カードと一緒にお持ちください。お勤めの確認に使います。申込書に記入するご本人の電話番号も用意しておいてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SAG-URESHINO-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, bring them with the card to confirm employment. Have your own phone number ready for the application too.

DLG-SC-LOC-SAG-URESHINO-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SAG-URESHINO-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 自分の電話番号はあります。口座ができるまで、会社には今使っている口座へ振り込めるか相談したほうがいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SAG-URESHINO-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自分の電話番号はあると伝え、開設まで現在の口座へ振り込めるか勤務先に相談すべきか尋ねる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SAG-URESHINO-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have my own number. Until the account opens, should I ask my company whether they can pay into my current account?
DLG-SC-LOC-SAG-URESHINO-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Mention your phone number and ask about discussing interim salary payment to the current account with work. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SAG-URESHINO-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SAG-URESHINO-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 給与の振込先は勤務先に確認してください。書類がそろっても確認に時間がかかる場合があるので、開設できる日をお約束することはできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-SAG-URESHINO-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Check salary payment destinations with your employer. Even with all papers, checking can take time, so we can't promise an opening date.

DLG-SC-LOC-SAG-URESHINO-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SAG-URESHINO-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日中にできるとは会社へ伝えないようにします。住所を更新したカード、会社の書類、電話番号を用意して、改めて申込みに来ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SAG-URESHINO-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本日開設できるとは会社に伝えず、住所更新後のカード、会社書類、電話番号を用意して再来店すると伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SAG-URESHINO-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I won't tell my company it can be done today. I'll prepare the address-updated card, company papers and phone number and return to apply.
DLG-SC-LOC-SAG-URESHINO-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Avoid promising same-day opening and return with updated card, company papers and phone number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SAG-URESHINO-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SAG-URESHINO-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 持ち物の一覧もお渡しします。次回、内容を確認して申込みをお受けします。本日はありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-SAG-URESHINO-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll give you a checklist too. Next time we'll check the contents and accept the application. Thank you for coming.

DLG-SC-SHG-HIKONE-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-SHG-HIKONE-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ここから先は、歩きながら短くご説明します。
DLG-SC-SHG-HIKONE-001-SHARED-01.translation: From here I'll give short explanations while we walk.

DLG-SC-SHG-HIKONE-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-SHG-HIKONE-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 説明をノートに書きたいのですが、歩きながらだと足元を見られません。次に止まった時、要点を聞き直してもよいですか。
DLG-SC-SHG-HIKONE-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 歩き書きで足元を見られず停止時に要点の再説明を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-SHG-HIKONE-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like notes, but writing while walking prevents me watching my footing. May I ask the key points again at the next stop?
DLG-SC-SHG-HIKONE-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain writing while walking prevents watching your step and request key points when stopped. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-SHG-HIKONE-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-SHG-HIKONE-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 次の広場で休憩します。その時に、ご質問を伺います。
DLG-SC-SHG-HIKONE-001-SHARED-03.translation: We'll rest at the next plaza. I'll take questions then.

DLG-SC-SHG-HIKONE-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-SHG-HIKONE-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: では、ここではペンをしまって聞きます。書くために一人だけ後ろへ残るのはやめます。
DLG-SC-SHG-HIKONE-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 歩行中はペンをしまい記録のため一人残らないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-SHG-HIKONE-001-SHARED-04.translation: Then I'll put my pen away here and listen. I won't stay behind alone to write.
DLG-SC-SHG-HIKONE-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Put the pen away while walking and avoid staying alone for notes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-SHG-HIKONE-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-SHG-HIKONE-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 後で確かめたい話題があれば、短い言葉だけ覚えておいてください。
DLG-SC-SHG-HIKONE-001-SHARED-05.translation: If there's a topic to check later, remember just a short keyword.

DLG-SC-SHG-HIKONE-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-SHG-HIKONE-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 石垣の話が気になっています。全部をもう一度話してほしいのではなく、形を見るときのポイントを聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-SHG-HIKONE-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 石垣を見るポイントだけを聞き直したいと範囲を絞る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-SHG-HIKONE-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'm interested in the stone-wall explanation. I don't need everything repeated; I'd like the points for looking at its shape.
DLG-SC-SHG-HIKONE-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Limit the repeat request to points for viewing stone walls. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-SHG-HIKONE-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-SHG-HIKONE-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 広場に着きました。石垣のどの部分について知りたいですか。
DLG-SC-SHG-HIKONE-001-SHARED-07.translation: We've reached the plaza. Which part of the wall interests you?

DLG-SC-SHG-HIKONE-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-SHG-HIKONE-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 角の部分です。遠くから全体を見る説明と、角を近くから見る説明があり、その二つをノートで分けたいです。
DLG-SC-SHG-HIKONE-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 全体と角の見方をノートで分けたいと具体的に聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-SHG-HIKONE-001-SHARED-08.translation: The corners. There was an explanation about viewing the whole from far away and one about corners up close; I'd like separate notes for those.
DLG-SC-SHG-HIKONE-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Specifically request separating overall and corner viewing in notes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-SHG-HIKONE-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-SHG-HIKONE-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 全体では傾き、角では石の組み合わせを見る、というお話でした。
DLG-SC-SHG-HIKONE-001-SHARED-09.translation: The explanation was to see the slope overall and how stones fit together at corners.

DLG-SC-SHG-HIKONE-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-SHG-HIKONE-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 全体の傾きと、角の組み合わせですね。今、二行に分けて書けました。歩く時はまたノートを閉じます。
DLG-SC-SHG-HIKONE-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 全体の傾きと角の組み合わせを二行に記し歩く時は閉じる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-SHG-HIKONE-001-SHARED-10.translation: Overall slope and corner stone arrangement, then. I've written two separate lines now. I'll close my notebook again when walking.
DLG-SC-SHG-HIKONE-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Note overall slope and corner arrangement in two lines and close the notebook while walking. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-SHG-HIKONE-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-SHG-HIKONE-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 質問できてよかったですね。次の案内役へ引き継ぎます。それでは、見学をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-SHG-HIKONE-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'm glad you could ask. I'll hand over to the next guide. Enjoy the visit.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 床板をご覧になって、記録したい所がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything in the floorboards you want to record?

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 木目が面白いので、紙を床に置いて上から鉛筆でこすれば模様が写ると思いました。ここでやってもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 床へ紙を置き鉛筆で木目をこすり出せるか事前に尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: The grain is interesting, so I thought putting paper on the floor and rubbing with a pencil would copy it. May I do that here?
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in advance about paper-and-pencil rubbing of floor grain. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 展示の床へ紙や鉛筆を押し当てることはできません。離れてご覧になり、ご自身の紙へ描くことはできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can't press paper or pencils against the exhibit floor. You may view from a distance and draw on your own paper.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 紙越しなら床に触れていないと思っていましたが、押し当てる方法はやめます。見て線を描きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 紙越しでも接触する方法をやめ見て線を描くと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought paper between meant I wasn't touching the floor, but I won't use the pressing method. I'd like to draw the lines by looking.
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Stop rubbing even through paper and draw observed lines instead. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 紙を支える物はお持ちですか。床へ広げず、手元で描いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do you have something to support the paper? Draw in your hands rather than spread it on the floor.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 小さな板を持っています。その上に紙を置き、床の上へ鉛筆や消しゴムを置かないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 持参板で手元の紙を支え道具を展示床へ置かないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have a small board. I'll put paper on it and won't place pencils or erasers on the floor.
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Support handheld paper with your own board and keep tools off the exhibit floor. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 通路をふさがないこちらの位置でご覧いただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can view from this spot without blocking the passage.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: こちらへ寄りました。一本の板だけを見て線の曲がり方を描きます。床全部を描くために人の前へ移動し続けるのはやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 指定位置から一本だけを描き全床のため人の前へ移動し続けない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've moved here. I'll look at just one board and draw its curves, rather than keep moving in front of people to draw the entire floor.
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Draw one board from the designated position without moving in front of people to cover the whole floor. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 床板の詳しい材質は、解説で確認してください。木目の見た目だけでは決められません。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Check the description for the precise wood material. Grain appearance alone doesn't determine it.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 材質は断定せず、見た線の形として記録します。描き終えたら紙を持ち、鉛筆も鞄にしまって次の展示へ行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 材質を見た目で断定せず線形を記録し紙と道具を片付けて次へ行く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I won't assert the material; I'll record the shapes I see. When finished I'll take my paper, put the pencil in my bag and go to the next exhibit.
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Avoid material assumptions, record line shapes and pack paper and tools before moving on. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞ、離れた位置からご覧ください。それでは、見学とスケッチをお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please view from a distance. Enjoy looking and sketching.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お選びの土産は、こちらの四箱ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Your selected souvenirs are these four boxes, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: まだ会計を待ってください。友人と二箱ずつ買う予定でしたが、今、その友人が買わないと連絡してきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人が購入辞退したため四箱の会計をまだ待ってほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Please hold off payment. My friend and I planned two boxes each, but they've just told me they won't buy any.
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Request holding the four-box checkout because your friend declined. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: では、何箱をお買いになりますか。まだ包装は始めていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Then how many will you buy? We haven't begun wrapping yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 自分の二箱だけです。友人からお金を預かっているわけでもないので、その分を私が立て替えることはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自分用二箱のみと指定し未受金なので友人分は立替えないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Only my own two. I haven't received money from my friend, so I won't pay their share in advance.
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Specify your two only and no advance purchase for your friend without their money. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 外す二箱は、同じ種類のこちらでよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Are these two of the same type the ones to remove?

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、同じ種類です。友人の分を別の人へ配る予定に変えず、二箱を購入から外します。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 同種二箱を他人への配布へ変えず購入から外すと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, the same type. I won't change my plan to give my friend's share to someone else; I'll remove those two from the purchase.
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Remove two same-kind boxes instead of repurposing them as gifts for others. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 承知しました。残りの二箱を一緒に包みますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood. Shall I wrap the remaining two together?

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 一箱ずつお願いします。自分が訪ねる二軒へ渡すので、まとめて一つに包むと分けにくくなります。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 訪問先二軒に渡すため残り二箱を個別包装で頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: One each, please. They're for two homes I'll visit, and wrapping together would make dividing them difficult.
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request individual wrapping for two separate visits. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 二箱それぞれ包装しました。お会計も二箱分になっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Both are wrapped separately. The bill is for two boxes too.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二箱分の金額を確認できました。友人には購入を外したと連絡し、私が買った二箱だけ持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二箱の金額を確認して友人へ辞退分を外したと連絡する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've checked the amount for two. I'll tell my friend their share was removed and take home only the two I bought.
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the two-box charge and tell your friend the declined share was removed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。それでは、お土産をお渡しする日も楽しい一日になりますように。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. I hope the day you give the souvenirs is enjoyable too.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: そばは、あと一人前だけになっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Only one serving of soba remains.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 二人で来ました。一人前を半分ずつにできますか。ただ、それだけでは二人とも足りないと思っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 残り一人前を二分できるか尋ね二人には不足と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: There are two of us. Can you divide one serving in half? But I think that alone won't be enough for either of us.
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to split the remaining serving and explain it is insufficient for two. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 二つの器に分けることはできます。別にご飯の料理もご用意できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: We can divide it into two bowls and also provide a rice dish separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 半分のそばを二人分と数えるのではなく、そば一人前と、ご飯の料理一つを注文したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: そば一人前とご飯料理一つを別品として指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'd like one serving of soba and one rice dish, rather than counting the soba halves as two servings.
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Specify one soba serving and one rice dish as separate items. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: そばを分けるのは、そのままでよろしいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do you still want the soba divided?

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、少しずつ味を楽しみたいので分けてください。ご飯の料理は私が食べ、同行者には別の追加を選んでもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: そば分割を続けご飯は自分用で同行者は追加を選ぶと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, we both want a small taste. I'll eat the rice dish, and my companion will choose a separate addition.
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Continue the soba split, assign rice to yourself and let your companion choose an extra. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 同行者の方には、この追加の一覧をご覧いただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Your companion can see this extras list.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 見てもらいました。同行者は小さな天ぷらを一皿希望しています。そばをもう一人前作ってほしいという依頼ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同行者の天ぷら一皿希望を伝えそば再製造の依頼ではないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: They've looked. They'd like one small plate of tempura. We're not asking you to make another soba serving.
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request your companion's small tempura plate and clarify this is not a request for more soba. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そば一人前を二つに分け、ご飯の料理一つと小さな天ぷら一皿ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: One soba serving divided in two, one rice dish and a small tempura plate, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: その三品でお願いします。分けたそばの片方を、普通の一人前だと思わないように二人で確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 三品を確定し二分したそばは各通常一人前ではないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Those three, please. We'll both make sure not to mistake either soba half for a normal full serving.
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm three items and that each divided half is not a full serving. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、それぞれのお料理をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. Enjoy each of your dishes.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どちらまでお送りしましょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 宿に大きい鞄を置いてから美術館へ行きたいです。荷物を預ける間、待っていただくことはできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 宿で荷物を置く間のタクシー待機を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to leave my large bag at my accommodation and then go to the museum. Could you wait while I leave it?
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Discuss taxi waiting while leaving luggage at accommodation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 待つ場合の料金と時間の扱いを先に確認しましょう。宿では、すぐ預けられる予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's first check how waiting time and charges work. Do you expect to leave it immediately at the accommodation?

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ宿へ連絡していません。受付が混んでいれば何分で戻れるか分からないので、すぐ戻るとは約束できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 宿未連絡で預け時間不明のため即戻るとは約束できないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I haven't contacted them yet. If reception is busy I don't know how many minutes I'd need, so I can't promise to return immediately.
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain no accommodation contact and uncertain deposit time, without promising immediate return. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 宿までの移動だけにして、その後に別の車を手配する方法もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Another option is just the trip to the accommodation and arranging a different car afterward.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今日は宿までで乗車を終えます。待ってもらう時間を決められないまま、美術館までの往復として頼むのはやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 不明な待機を頼まず宿までで一旦乗車を終えると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll end this ride at the accommodation today. I won't request a round trip via the museum with an undecided wait.
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Avoid unspecified waiting and end the ride at the accommodation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 宿の入口が分かる案内をお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you have directions showing the accommodation entrance?

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: こちらの案内です。表通りではなく、鞄を預ける受付のある入口を宿へ電話で確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 宿の案内を示し荷物受付の入口を停車中に電話で確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Here. I'll phone them to confirm the entrance for luggage reception rather than just the main street.
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show directions and phone while stopped to check the luggage-reception entrance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認が終わってから出発できます。電話はこの停車中にどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: We can leave after you finish checking. Please call while we're stopped.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 宿が受付の入口を教えてくれました。そこまでお願いします。美術館への次の車は、荷物を預けた後に自分で相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確認した入口を指定し次の観光移動は預けた後に手配すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: They've told me the reception entrance. Please take me there. I'll arrange the next museum ride myself after leaving the bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Specify the confirmed entrance and arrange later sightseeing transport after depositing luggage. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、その入口までお送りします。ご乗車ください。それでは、宿でのお過ごしもお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I'll take you to that entrance. Please get in. Enjoy your time at the accommodation too.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 清掃後の配置を研修用に記録する予定ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're planning to record the post-cleaning layout for training.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。でも机にお客様の書類があります。部屋全体を撮ると名前も写るので、まだ撮影していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 研修写真へ客の名前入り書類が写るため未撮影と報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, but customer documents are on the desk. A whole-room photo would show names, so I haven't photographed anything yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report no photo because customer names would be visible in training pictures. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この研修では備品の配置だけを記録します。お客様の書類は動かさず、写らない範囲を決めましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: For this training, record only the equipment layout. Don't move customer papers; let's choose a frame excluding them.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 備品だけですね。書類を裏返してから撮るのではなく、机を画面から外す方法を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 書類を動かさず机を撮影範囲から外す案を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Only equipment, then. Rather than turn papers over, I'd like to discuss leaving the desk outside the frame.
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Discuss excluding the desk without moving papers. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 研修に必要なのは入口側の備品です。机は対象ではありません。会社指定の端末は持っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Training needs entrance-side equipment; the desk isn't relevant. Do you have the company-designated device?

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 指定の端末があります。自分の携帯で撮って後から送る方法は使いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 会社端末を持ち私用携帯から後送信はしないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I won't photograph with my personal phone and send it later.
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Use the company device and avoid later sending from a personal phone. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 入口側から見た範囲を、撮影前に私へ示してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Show me the entrance-side frame before photographing.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この角度なら備品棚だけが入ります。鏡に机が映り込んでいないかも、一緒に見ていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 備品棚だけの角度を示し鏡への書類映込みも確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: This angle includes only the equipment shelf. Could you also check that the desk doesn't appear reflected in the mirror?
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show an equipment-only angle and request a mirror-reflection check. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 鏡にも書類は入っていません。記録の保存先は、指定の研修フォルダーです。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: No documents are reflected either. Save the record in the designated training folder.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 指定範囲を一枚記録して、指定先へ保存します。お客様の書類の内容を研修メモへ書き写すこともしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確認範囲を指定先へ保存し書類内容を研修メモへ転記しないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll record one photo of the approved area and save it there. I won't copy customer-document contents into training notes either.
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Save the approved frame to the designated place and avoid copying document contents into notes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 範囲を確認できました。記録後は別の指導係へ提出してください。それでは、また研修でお会いしましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: The frame is checked. Submit the record to the other instructor afterward. See you again in training.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 足元のマットをお使いください。雨が強かったですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please use the floor mat. The rain was heavy.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 上着から水が落ちています。このまま売場を歩いて商品を濡らしたくないので、入口で少し整えてから入ってもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 濡れた上着で商品を濡らさないため入口で整えたいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Water is dripping from my jacket. I don't want to wet products while walking the aisles; may I sort myself out a little at the entrance first?
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Request tidying a wet jacket at the entrance to avoid wetting products. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ほかの方が通れるよう、マットの横でお願いします。傘はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Beside the mat, so others can pass. Do you have an umbrella?

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 傘は閉じました。上着を絞って店の床へ水を落とすことはせず、持っている吸水布で押さえます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 閉じた傘と吸水布を説明し床へ絞らないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I've closed it. I won't wring my jacket onto the shop floor; I'll blot it with the absorbent cloth I have.
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain a closed umbrella and absorbent cloth, without wringing water onto the floor. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 落ち着かれたら買物へどうぞ。急ぎで必要な物はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Once settled, please shop. Is there anything urgent you need?

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 水を一本だけ買いたいです。入口の棚にある物でよいので、店内を一周する必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 水一本のみ必要で店内一周は不要と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Only one water bottle. One on the entrance shelf is fine, so I don't need to walk around the whole shop.
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Need only one water and no full-store round. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの棚をご案内します。手が滑るようでしたらお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll show this shelf. Tell me if your hands slip.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 布で手も拭けました。一本をかごへ入れてレジへ行きます。濡れた上着を商品棚へ掛けないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 手を拭いて一本をかごへ入れ上着を棚に掛けないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've dried my hands too. I'll put one bottle in a basket and go to the till, without hanging my wet jacket on product shelves.
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Dry hands, basket one bottle and avoid hanging the jacket on shelves. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お会計が済んだら、袋へ入れるかもお選びいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: After paying, you can choose whether to bag it too.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 自分の防水袋に入れます。外へ出てから上着を着直すので、入口を長くふさいで着替えることはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自分の防水袋へ入れ外で着直して入口を塞がないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll use my own waterproof bag. I'll put my jacket back on outside rather than block the entrance for a long change.
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Use your waterproof bag and put the jacket on outside without blocking entry. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。それでは、夜道もお気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. Take care on the roads at night too.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 海外へお送りになるお手紙でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this a letter you're sending abroad?

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。便箋に加えて乾燥した花を一枚入れたいです。紙に挟んでいますが、紙だけの手紙として説明してよいか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 手紙へ押し花同封予定を紙だけと説明してよいか相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I'd like to include a dried flower with the writing paper. It's between paper, but I'm unsure whether I may describe it as a paper-only letter.
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Discuss whether a letter with a pressed flower may be described as paper only. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 内容は省略せずお知らせください。送り先と同封する物を確認してから取扱いを調べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Tell us all the contents. We'll check the destination and enclosed items before researching handling.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 送り先はこちらの国です。花はまだ封筒へ入れていません。薄いから何も説明しなくてよいと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 送り先を示し花は未封入で薄さから説明不要と思っていたと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: The destination is this country. I haven't put the flower in the envelope yet. I thought thinness meant no explanation was needed.
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the destination and explain the flower is not enclosed and thinness led you to assume disclosure unnecessary. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 薄さだけでは判断できません。こちらでは、確認前に送れるとお約束できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Thinness alone doesn't determine it. We can't promise it can be sent before checking.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 送れると言われたつもりで封をせず、確認を待ちます。花が難しければ、今日は便箋だけ送ることも考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 可否未確認で封をせず花なし便箋発送も検討すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I won't seal it as though permission had been given; I'll wait. If the flower is difficult, I might send only the letter today.
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Leave unsealed while permission is unknown and consider sending the paper without the flower. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 花の種類が分かる情報はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you have information identifying the flower type?

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 自宅で育てた物ですが、種類の正式な名前は覚えていません。名前を推測して書かず、家の札を確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 花の正式種類は不明で推測せず自宅札を調べると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I grew it at home, but don't remember its formal name. I won't guess a name; I'll check its label at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain the formal species is unknown and check the home label without guessing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 情報がそろってから改めてご相談ください。手紙だけ送る場合も、別に受付条件を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Consult again when you have the information. A paper-only letter also requires its own acceptance check.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は花も便箋も持ち帰ります。札を確かめ、同封するかを決めてから、内容を正確に伝えて相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 両方持帰り札確認と同封決定後に正確な内容で再相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll take both flower and letter home today. After checking the label and deciding whether to include it, I'll explain the exact contents and consult again.
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Take both home, check the label and enclosure decision and return with accurate contents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 分かりました。必要な情報がそろいましたらお越しください。それでは、お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-HIKONE-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please return when the needed information is ready. Take care.

DLG-SC-SHG-KUSATSU-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-SHG-KUSATSU-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: そのケースについて、何かご質問ですか。
DLG-SC-SHG-KUSATSU-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a question about that carrier?

DLG-SC-SHG-KUSATSU-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-SHG-KUSATSU-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 中には飼っている猫がいます。普通の荷物とだけ伝えて乗る前に、動物を連れて移動する条件を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-SHG-KUSATSU-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: ケース内に猫がいると明示し普通荷物として乗る前に条件を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-SHG-KUSATSU-001-SHARED-02.translation: My pet cat is inside. Before boarding while describing it only as ordinary luggage, I'd like to check the conditions for traveling with an animal.
DLG-SC-SHG-KUSATSU-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Clearly disclose the cat and ask conditions before treating it as ordinary luggage. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-SHG-KUSATSU-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-SHG-KUSATSU-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 猫が入っていることを、受付の担当へ伝えます。ケースの大きさが分かる資料はありますか。
DLG-SC-SHG-KUSATSU-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll tell reception there is a cat inside. Do you have information showing the carrier size?

DLG-SC-SHG-KUSATSU-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-SHG-KUSATSU-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 購入した時の寸法の案内があります。入れ物が小さく見えるから何でも同じ条件だとは判断しないようにします。
DLG-SC-SHG-KUSATSU-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 購入時寸法の資料を示し見た目の小ささで扱いを決めないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-SHG-KUSATSU-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have the dimensions from purchase. I won't assume everything has the same conditions because the carrier looks small.
DLG-SC-SHG-KUSATSU-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show purchase dimensions and avoid judging handling from apparent smallness. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-SHG-KUSATSU-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-SHG-KUSATSU-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ケースと内容を担当が確認します。ご自身の乗車券は、もうお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-SHG-KUSATSU-001-SHARED-05.translation: The staff will check the carrier and contents. Do you already have your own ticket?

DLG-SC-SHG-KUSATSU-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-SHG-KUSATSU-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 自分の券はあります。券を買えたので猫の扱いも確認済みだと思っていましたが、まだ別に相談していません。
DLG-SC-SHG-KUSATSU-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人券購入済みだが動物利用条件は未相談と区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-SHG-KUSATSU-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I thought buying my ticket meant the cat arrangements were checked too, but I haven't discussed them separately yet.
DLG-SC-SHG-KUSATSU-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish your purchased ticket from unconfirmed animal conditions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-SHG-KUSATSU-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-SHG-KUSATSU-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 乗車券の購入と、動物を連れての利用確認は分けて進めましょう。どちらまで移動する予定ですか。
DLG-SC-SHG-KUSATSU-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's handle ticket purchase and animal acceptance separately. How far are you going?

DLG-SC-SHG-KUSATSU-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-SHG-KUSATSU-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 二駅先までです。今日の移動だけで、毎日同じ条件で通えるという案内を求めているわけではありません。
DLG-SC-SHG-KUSATSU-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 二駅先までの本日移動と示し毎日の利用条件保証の質問ではないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-SHG-KUSATSU-001-SHARED-08.translation: Two stations away. Just today's trip; I'm not asking for assurance of the same conditions for daily commuting.
DLG-SC-SHG-KUSATSU-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Specify today's two-station trip without requesting a daily-use guarantee. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-SHG-KUSATSU-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-SHG-KUSATSU-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 行き先も担当へ伝えます。取扱いの確認が終わるまで、お乗りになるのはお待ちください。
DLG-SC-SHG-KUSATSU-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll tell the staff the destination too. Please wait to board until the handling check is complete.

DLG-SC-SHG-KUSATSU-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-SHG-KUSATSU-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 確認を待ちます。自分だけ先に乗って猫のケースをホームへ残すことはせず、利用できる方法が分かってから一緒に移動します。
DLG-SC-SHG-KUSATSU-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確認前に乗らず猫ケースをホームに残して先行もしないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-SHG-KUSATSU-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll wait. I won't board ahead and leave the cat carrier on the platform; we'll travel together after I know an acceptable method.
DLG-SC-SHG-KUSATSU-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Wait before boarding and avoid leaving the cat carrier behind while going ahead. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-SHG-KUSATSU-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-SHG-KUSATSU-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、ケースと寸法の案内を持って担当へご相談ください。それでは、お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-SHG-KUSATSU-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then take the carrier and dimension information to the staff for consultation. Take care.
